briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF M-017
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- office roof: (106, -75), roof
- solar canopy: (-38, -84), roof
- storage hall: (4, 127), indoor
- pump house: (105, 147), indoor
- workcell West: (-102, -47), indoor
- east fence: (116, 88), outdoor
- antenna mast: (67, 73), outdoor
- south yard: (47, 146), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 6.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1440 s, including the return to its start.
- A1 (fixed_arm): installed at workcell West and cannot move; it can only work on tasks located at workcell West. Equipment: robotic arm. Mains-powered (no endurance limit).
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1020 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 7 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2460 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1260 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Deliver the toolkit (7 kg) to workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 240 s.
- T2: Replace the filter cartridge at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T3: Tighten the valve at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 660 s. Can start only after T1 is finished.
- T4: Inspect solar canopy with a camera. Location: solar canopy. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T5: Tighten the valve at south yard. Location: south yard. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 1020 s.
- T6: Replace the filter cartridge at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 210 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T10 is finished.
- T7: Photograph storage hall for the condition report. Location: storage hall. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.
- T8: Collect a soil sample (2 kg) at east fence and keep it on board. Location: east fence. Duration: 60 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 2 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 540 s.
- T9: Deliver the spare pump (7 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 660 s.
- T10: Deliver the first-aid kit (7 kg) to workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 7 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Every task must be finished by t = 1800 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Hi team, here is today's job at the site.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: office roof (106, -75, a rooftop); solar canopy (-38, -84, a rooftop); storage hall (4, 127, indoors); pump house (105, 147, indoors); workcell West (-102, -47, indoors); east fence (116, 88, outside); antenna mast (67, 73, outside); south yard (47, 146, outside).

The fleet: D1 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 6.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 24 minutes including the flight home. A1 is a robot arm bolted down in workcell West; it can't move but can work on jobs inside workcell West, and it runs on mains power. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 9.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 17 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 7 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 41 minutes including getting back. D3, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 7 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 21 minutes of flight time, return trip included.

Jobs:
(T1) Drop the toolkit off at workcell West; it weighs 7 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 4 minutes.
(T2) Change the filter at workcell West - that takes 5 minutes on site.
(T3) The valve at workcell West needs tightening - that takes 4.5 minutes on site but only once the toolkit (T1) has arrived and it has to be finished within the first 11 minutes.
(T4) Do a visual check of solar canopy - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T5) Someone has to tighten the valve at south yard - that takes 4.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 17 minutes.
(T6) Swap the filter cartridge at workcell West - that takes 3.5 minutes on site but only once the first-aid kit (T10) has arrived.
(T7) Document storage hall with pictures - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T8) Pick up a soil sample at east fence and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 9 minutes.
(T9) Drop the spare pump off at pump house; it weighs 7 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 11 minutes.
(T10) Workcell West needs the first-aid kit, which weighs 7 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.

Everything has to be wrapped up within 30 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
